title: Data-Science-Thesis
summary: A postgraduate data-science thesis project analyzing insurance policy fund-switch behaviour, building supplementary predictive features from tax, asset, premium, broker and client attributes before feeding a final dataset into a Data Robot ML catalog. The thesis notebooks import SDV's SingleTableMetadata and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer (with CTGANSynthesizer also imported) to fit, save, and sample a synthetic replacement for the real policy-level dataset, then check it with evaluate_quality and run_diagnostic.
